div.head: straits.
div.p: 11. The following persons shall be entitled to registration under this ordinance.

list.label: (a)
list.item: The holder of any British Indian of British colonial degree, diploma, or license entitling him to practice medicine and surgery.
list.label: (b)
list.item: The holder of a degree or license in medicine and surgery of any medical school in Europe, the United States of America, or the Empire of Japan, the degrees, diplomas, and licenses of which are recognized as entitling to registration by the general council of medical education and registration in the United Kingdom.
list.label: (c)
list.item: Persons already in practice in the colony possessing the degrees or diplomas of a regular school of medicine and surgery who shall satisfy the medical council as to the validity of their qualifications.

div.p: Provided that any person who can satisfy the medical council that he has been engaged in medical practice in the colony for not less than six months immediately preceding the commencement of this ordinance shall be entitled to submit himself for examination by the medical council in medicine surgery, including clinical medicine and surgery, midwifery and therapeutics, within three months from the commencement of this ordinance, and in the event of his satisfying the said medical council that he possesses a competent knowledge of the said subjects he shall be entitled to registration under this ordinance.
